book: Shared Book Statue: closed while inactive; opening, hovering and curved page turns while active
timer: T1: 360 seconds starting at first Book activation, shared across all five challenges; wrong answers and next Book interactions preserve the deadline; completion freezes remaining time
timeout: Keep solved challenges; cancel the unfinished rune; record exactly one timeout mistake for the current activating player; next Book activation retries the unfinished challenge with a fresh 360-second attempt
limitations: Physical Android and remote rendered UI were not verified.
Timeout tests used shortened deadlines instead of waiting six real minutes.
World captions are capped in size, repositioned, or hidden locally when no clear space is available.
